 g=[row[:] for row in grid]

 # Identify monochrome rectangular outlines by their bounding box. Interior rule learned from demos: 3x3 centers become 7; larger interiors become 2.
 colors=set(v for row in g for v in row if v!=bg)
 for color in colors:
  pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==color]
  r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
  # rectangular perimeter
  perimeter={(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)}
  if set(pts)==perimeter:
   fill=7 if (r1-r0==2 and c1-c0==2) else 2
   for r in range(r0+1,r1):
    for c in range(c0+1,c1): g[r][c]=fill
 return g
''')
